properties.description: Eight MCP tests for requirement A. An unestablished objection contests rather than refutes. A reply that holds answers it. An established objection refutes. Two claims that object to each other are both contested. A contested Decision keeps a dispute open and is not a defect. reasoning_report reads an argument end to end, and one claim reads only what is under it. A design with no reasoning says so, and a missing claim is refused.
